body_content.text: When a water heater quits in The Vistas, an AC system stalls during a 110°F afternoon in The Paseos, or a slow drain backs up in a custom estate near The Hills, Right On Plumbing, Heating and Air is the local team that answers. We're based right here in Summerlin South, so this is our home turf — the neighborhoods near Downtown Summerlin, the elevated lots edging the Red Rock Canyon foothills, and the family streets surrounding The Vistas Park. Five years serving this community has taught us exactly how the desert treats your home: very hard municipal water that scales pipes and water heaters, fine dust that loads up ductwork, and a cooling season that pushes equipment to its limits. Whatever the issue, we get your plumbing, heating, and cooling working *right* — fast.
Air Conditioning Installation in Summerlin South

Summerlin South summers routinely climb past 105°F, and the area's larger single-family and multi-story homes demand cooling capacity that's correctly sized for elevated desert lots and long cooling seasons. Whether you're building a custom estate or upgrading a late-1990s production home, proper AC installation makes the difference between a comfortable house and runaway NV Energy bills.

Many of the homes built across The Vistas and The Paseos in the late 1990s and 2000s now carry original units worn down by back-to-back triple-digit Mojave summers. Replacing them with high-efficiency equipment restores reliable comfort.

For energy-conscious HOA communities chasing high SEER ratings and the spacious open-floor-plan homes common throughout Summerlin South, whole-home and central systems deliver even cooling from room to room.

Air Conditioning Repair in Summerlin South

Summerlin South AC systems run nearly nonstop through the Mojave summer, and a breakdown can let dangerous heat build up indoors within hours. Our same-day repairs cover every common failure point the desert heat creates.

Capacitors, compressors, and fan motors take the hardest beating during 110°F afternoons that force units to run at full capacity. These parts wear out fast in Summerlin South, and we stock and replace them quickly to restore cooling.

When a Summerlin South system can't keep up with desert temperatures, the cause is often a refrigerant leak, low charge, or a unit that won't start at all. We diagnose and correct the problem so your home cools again.
Air Duct Cleaning in Summerlin South

Sitting at the western edge of the valley near Red Rock and open desert, Summerlin South homes pull fine dust and pollen into their ductwork year-round. That buildup affects indoor air quality and forces systems to work harder, so cleaning and sealing the ducts pays off in comfort and efficiency.
In Summerlin South's bone-dry climate, lint-packed dryer vents are a real fire hazard. We clear them out and keep your laundry running safely.
Leaky or damaged ducts in Summerlin South attics waste expensive cooling. We seal, repair, and install ductwork for additions and remodels throughout the community.
Drainage and Sewer Service in Summerlin South

Hard, mineral-laden water and occasional monsoon runoff create drainage headaches for Summerlin South homes. From scale-clogged kitchen lines to aging sewer laterals in established neighborhoods, we handle it all while protecting your landscaping and HOA curb appeal.
Mineral and grease clogs are common in Summerlin South kitchens and baths thanks to the valley's hard water. Routine cleaning and high-pressure jetting keep lines flowing.

Summerlin South's sloped lots near the foothills can take on monsoon-season runoff, and older neighborhoods may have failing sewer lines. Camera inspections, French drains, and trenchless repair restore function with minimal disruption to your property.

Summerlin South winter nights occasionally dip near freezing, and when a desert cold front rolls in you need heat that works. We repair furnaces, boilers, and heat pumps fast so your home stays warm through the cold snaps.
For homes with hydronic or radiant heating, and the many Summerlin South residences running efficient dual-mode heat pumps, we keep the core systems running reliably.

When a Summerlin South furnace won't fire on a cold morning, the culprit is usually a worn ignitor, a dirty flame sensor, a failed blower motor, or a cracked heat exchanger. We diagnose and replace these components to restore safe, steady heat.

Most Summerlin South homes rely on heat pumps and gas furnaces sized for mild desert winters with the occasional freeze. As original equipment ages out across the established neighborhoods, upgrading to efficient new systems lowers operating costs and improves comfort.

Heat pumps are an ideal match for Summerlin South's mild-winter, hot-summer climate, while gas and electric furnaces serve homes on natural gas or all-electric service. We size and install each system for the property.
For room additions, casitas, and converted home offices needing zoned comfort, baseboard heaters and ductless mini splits add heat where the main system can't reach.
Summerlin South's custom homes and high-end remodels often call for boilers and radiant floor heating — premium comfort that fits the area's luxury housing stock.
HVAC Services and Air Quality in Summerlin South

Summerlin South homeowners invest in smart, high-efficiency HVAC and air quality upgrades to manage a harsh desert environment. From pre-summer tune-ups to whole-home air treatment, we keep systems efficient and indoor air clean.
Summerlin South systems run under heavy demand through 100°F-plus summers. Inspections, maintenance plans, and seasonal tune-ups catch worn parts before peak cooling season and extend equipment life.
Smart Controls and Indoor Air Quality

Tech-forward Summerlin South homeowners use smart thermostats to manage NV Energy peak rates, while air scrubbers, UV purifiers, humidifiers, and dehumidifiers tackle desert dust, dry winter air, and humid monsoon weeks inside tightly sealed homes.
Commercial Mechanical Contracting in Summerlin South

The commercial corridors and retail centers near Town Center Drive and Downtown Summerlin require robust mechanical systems built for heavy desert cooling loads. We install and service the equipment that keeps offices, restaurants, and retail plazas running.
Chillers, commercial boilers, and full HVAC systems serve Summerlin South office buildings, medical offices, and retail plazas, with fast repair when a system fails during peak heat.
Summerlin South restaurants and commercial kitchens need proper ventilation, exhaust, and make-up air to stay code-compliant and comfortable for staff and guests.

Summerlin South's notoriously hard water and upscale homes drive steady demand for water treatment, fixture upgrades, and dependable plumbing. From slab leaks under villa homes to designer faucet installs in The Hills, our plumbers handle the full range.

The valley's very hard municipal water leaves scale on fixtures and wears water heaters down fast. Softeners and whole-house filtration protect your plumbing, while tankless and standard heaters serve both single and multi-story Summerlin South homes.

Summerlin South's high-end housing stock calls for luxury bathroom remodels and designer fixtures, and hard-water buildup means faucets and toilets need occasional repair. We install and service the lot, including high-efficiency toilets that support local water conservation.

Mineral scaling and aging plumbing affect Summerlin South homes, with slab leaks a frequent problem. We find leaks without tearing up your home, repair or repipe lines, and install gas lines for outdoor kitchens, pools, and fire features.

Burst pipes and major leaks don't wait for business hours, so we offer 24/7 emergency plumbing across Summerlin South. We also serve local businesses and retail tenants, and perform backflow testing to meet LVVWD requirements on irrigation systems.
Septic System Service in Summerlin South

Most Summerlin South homes are on city sewer, but custom and outlying properties near the desert edge sometimes rely on septic systems. We inspect, install, repair, and pump these systems for area properties that need them.
